prose: Bloomberg reports the annual Google, Temasek, and Bain e-economy study projects online spending in Southeast Asia will rise about 17% year over year to $368 billion in 2026 despite economic headwinds, as businesses harness AI to spur spending. The article could not be fetched, so this summary is limited to the headline.
highlights: SE Asia online spending projected at $368B in 2026, up ~17% YoY
Growth despite economic headwinds; AI credited with spurring spending
Annual study by Google, Temasek, and Bain
Source: Gabrielle Ng, Bloomberg, via Techmeme
basis: Basis: Techmeme headline only; the Bloomberg article fetch returned an error.
